name: smwgraphics-demon-s-crest-palace-of-decadence-exterior
title: Demon's Crest - Palace of Decadence (Exterior)
description:
The very fast cloud background seen in the exterior part of Phalanx's castle, from Demon's Crest. With the new scrolling options from Lunar Magic 3.40, it might possible to replicate the effect without using uberasm. A good fit for dark sky levels, in general.

Credit would be great, but it is optional.
